outcome: Seroprevalence of maternal toxoplasma and rubella
cohort: 3653 pregnant women attending the King Abdulaziz University Hospital, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, for antenatal follow-up between 2019 and 2022.
finding: The seroprevalence of toxoplasma IgM and rubella IgM was very low, suggesting a low risk of current infections during pregnancy, and the study questions the benefit of routine antenatal screening for these infections in this population.
